question: Should schema version 10 and its durable observation-order migration become the supported upgrade contract for released v0.7.1 stores?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but accepting a new canonical persisted-data model and its upgrade semantics is an ownership decision that automated checks cannot safely make.

options.title: Accept Schema 10
options.body: Merge after owner review, treating the demonstrated v0.7.1-to-v10 migration and durable ordering rules as the supported upgrade path.

options.title: Stage The Migration
options.body: Separate or narrow schema convergence if maintainers do not want the complete canonical-v10 contract to land in one release.

recommendation.title: Accept Schema 10
recommendation.body: Merge after owner review, treating the demonstrated v0.7.1-to-v10 migration and durable ordering rules as the supported upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged history makes this person the strongest available owner of the current thread-evidence, freshness, and workflow-snapshot architecture.
